name: research-planning-suite
description: Turn vague research ideas into falsifiable project contracts and prediction-annotated experiment roadmaps.

interface.shortDescription: Sharpen vague ideas into falsifiable project plans.
interface.longDescription: Captures the kernel of a vague research idea through one early interview, diverges into materially different candidate projects, kill-tests and selects autonomously, and delivers a project contract plus a prediction-annotated experiment roadmap with pre-committed surprise handling.
defaultPrompt: Sharpen this vague idea into a project contract and experiment roadmap.
I have a hunch - narrow it down and tell me what to run first.
Turn my notes into a prediction-annotated research plan.
